reviews.summary: The live site already satisfies every criterion: robots.txt disallows /go/, the checked /go/ page has noindex and redirects to the release notes, and the sitemap has no /go/ URLs. The no-commit closure matches the task's third negative case.

The line was already live on unflagged cards with fetched notes, and its date matches the build date, so closing without a commit fits the task. The wording differs slightly from the task's text, and the line sits on its own row below the 'release notes →' link instead of beside it.

The sampled /go/ links on the home page and on /pkg/pypi/openai/ all carry rel=nofollow (40 of 929 home matches, all 24 on the openai page). That agrees with the implementer's no-change report. build.json has errors == [], and the JSON and feed endpoints return 200.

Canonical links, unique titles and descriptions with version and date, the collapsed all-packages list on home, and lastmod on all 101 sitemap URLs are all live. The 200 status was checked on key pages and endpoints, not on every package URL. build.json has no errors and there are no /go/ URLs in the sitemap.

The sitemap now has per-URL lastmod values (11-05 to 11-18). The openai lastmod matches its newest release date, home equals the build date, there are no /go/ URLs, and all 98 /pkg/ pages are listed. Neighbouring endpoints and canonical tags are intact.

The home page has the 'Past a 7-day cooldown' section with a UTC window that ends exactly 7 days before the build time. Its flagged card matches the /pkg/ card, and the sampled /pkg/ links and the neighbouring endpoints return 200.
The live sitemap now lists /mcp/ with lastmod 2026-11-18. /mcp/ has the right canonical tag, the existing entries are kept, no /go/ URLs appear, and build.json reports no errors.

The Codex /pkg/ page shows six "Followed by X N h later (registry dates)" cards. The hours and versions match index.json's followed_by values and the record dates. The latest release has no line, openai index.json keeps its keys, and the required endpoints return 200 with build errors empty.
The llms.txt section is live and has the URL pattern, the openai example, the real keys, the /mcp/ link and the honest limits. All linked endpoints return 200 and build.json errors is empty.

The live codex page now folds platform builds into the base card's 'N platform builds' list, shown as version · date. The sampled builds are all present, build.json has no errors, and the JSON and feed endpoints return 200. The 375 px width, the base-missing group card and a before/after diff of pypi/openai could not be checked from outside.
Followed-by lines on the live site now name only same major.minor higher versions. ai 7.0.174 reads 7.0.175, SQLAlchemy has none, and Codex keeps matching lines and JSON keys.
The scoped URL strings agree between sitemap and canonical, and /brand/ is now linked in the footer and listed in the sitemap with a lastmod. All the other observable checks passed.

Both pages show the dated facts paragraph under the h1. The openai numbers match index.json, and the Checked date matches build.json. One oddity: the codex paragraph's "latest" is the newest record, 0.171.0-alpha.13-linux-x64, while the page's Latest version field says 0.170.0.

The live site shows the 'Notes are a PR list (auto-generated format)' label on the litellm 1.110.0 card. build.json has pr_list_notes 5 with no errors, and the litellm index.json records carry notes_format: pr_list. The release-notes target is a PR list, and the old endpoints and keys are intact.

The facts paragraph now names the same latest version as the Latest version field on both pages, with no platform suffix or pre-release tag. The R/S/F counts and the Checked date are intact, build.json errors is [], and the JSON and feed endpoints return 200.

po_digest_md:
**Release Radar — цикл 18.11, 21:07 UTC**

**Что произошло.** Приняты T-0137…T-0145: блок «Past a 7-day cooldown», строка «Followed by» (только та же линия major.minor), группировка платформенных сборок, раздел llms.txt для агентов, единый формат URL, абзац с фактами на /pkg/. Пост X 18.11 вышел (76 релизов, 9 с флагом). Слоты плана маркетинга до 24.11 уже есть в бэклоге как задачи.

**Метрики.** На 18.11 engaged-людей 1. «Людей» 90, но 138 запросов к /pkg/npm/@openai/codex/ похожи на ботов, фильтр метрик меняет ops. Агентов 623 против ~30 в обычный день. В индексе Google 0 из 101 URL.

**Решения.**
- OBS-0443: в абзаце фактов на странице codex «latest» указывает альфа-сборку для linux, а в соседнем поле стоит 0.170.0. Две разные версии на одной странице — это неправда. Создан дефект P2: абзац берёт то же значение, что поле «Latest version».
- Аналитику: разобрать всплеск агентов 18.11. Это реальный спрос G4 (после раздела в llms.txt и /mcp/) или один бот?
- T-0146 (метка «Notes are a PR list») остаётся в Ready, у неё есть гипотеза из голоса пользователей.

**Ждёт владельца.** Публикация на dev.to заблокирована недействительным API-ключом (Q-0025). Еженедельный свод не публикуется, пока владелец не обновит ключ. Фильтр «людей» в метриках тоже на ops/владельце.

**Стоимость.** Потрачено $9.30 из $20.

- **G4** (≥5 запросов /today.json не от краулеров и не от нас): за 18.11 /today.json дал 27 запросов, но у агентов 0 источников. Сделать вывод нельзя.

- **GSC:** 0 кликов, 697 показов, в индексе 0 из 101 URL.
- **Посты:** 18.11 в X вышел в 08:25, а в telegram с x переходов по ?src всего 1–2 визита за день. Эффекта поста не видно.
